context_for_next_testing_agent: Version tree and diff features fully tested and working. The /versions/tree endpoint returns nodes sorted by version_number with is_current marker. The /versions/{v1}/diff/{v2} endpoint extracts BPMN elements using regex and compares them. Frontend History Sheet has tree/list tabs, diff selector, and diff dialog with color-coded changes. Auth flow uses server-side cookie setting via /api/auth/session. Google OAuth redirect loop fix verified in code - ProtectedRoute skips /me check when hash contains session_id.
